pattern: QT-06 provider revises the quote upwards after approval, once works have started
notes: Mutation of event 034 (originally Ava Fletcher's email confirming completion of the job and attaching an invoice). Replaced, in the same third-person summary style, with her report that once the old toilet was taken out the soil pipe connector was cracked and the floor under the pan rotten, the old pan has been refitted temporarily, and the job is now £1,150 including VAT instead of the £420 originally quoted; she asks to go ahead this week. The original quote figure was not visible in the record (attachment unavailable), so £420 is stated in the mutated email. History truncated after event 034; the real continuation (completion checks, invoice) is gone. No attachments in the source. Expected: ASK the landlord to re-approve, hold the provider at the approved scope, tell the tenant there is a delay. No spend limit is on record, so escalating is acceptable but not required.
